description: Test class for ExternalLoginKeysManager, including unit tests for retrieving and generating external login keys via HTTP requests in the OfBiz framework.

classes.name: ExternalLoginKeysManagerTests
classes.description: JUnit test class testing methods of ExternalLoginKeysManager related to external login key retrieval and generation.

methods.name: getExternalLoginKeyReturnsKeyFromRequest
methods.description: Tests that ExternalLoginKeysManager correctly retrieves the external login key attribute from the request.

methods.name: getExternalLoginKeyReturnsEmptyKeyIfUserLoginIsNull
methods.description: Tests that the method returns an empty string if the user login attribute is null.

methods.name: getExternalLoginKeyReturnsKeyFromSessionForAjaxRequests
methods.description: Tests that the method retrieves the key from session attribute when the request indicates an AJAX request.

methods.name: getExternalLoginKeyGeneratesNewKey
methods.description: Tests that the method generates a new external login key, starting with 'EL', and sets it in request and session attributes.
